info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Mortgage Loans Documents-v4-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the retrieval of document records associated with mortgage loans. It enables financial institutions and service providers to access essential documentation needed for mortgage processing, underwriting, and customer inquiries. Typical consumers include loan officers, customer service representatives, and compliance teams who require documentation for audit and verification purposes. By utilizing this API, users can efficiently manage and access mortgage-related documents, improving overall operational efficiency.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch documents related to loans, providing important documentation for review and processing.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve documents related to loans. Ensure that all required parameters are included to receive the necessary loan document details.

200.description: The request was successful, and the loan documents have been retrieved.
